records.description: The repo is the command master — after install, every video is made by reading and using the repo's skills first. A skill that exists is used, never reinvented; a missing system is generated from the repo's own generation command and saved as a new skill; light details are delegated with direction from the repo; a new task type starts from the distilled common core; and when the repo has no instruction at all it says 'do it yourself' — never bare, always with the quality commands and the main flow attached. When a skill is missing, the skill is written and saved first, and the video is then made by following that new skill — the skill-first loop.
